failureSemantics.result: No untrusted content / network authority; setup typed fail closed.

harnessDesign.topology: Controlled synthetic-public hostname/address resolver + harness-only upstream transport maps validated test endpoint to local HTTP/TLS fixture. Explicit simulation, not a production exemption for loopback.
harnessDesign.separation: Production PUBLIC_ONLY classifier still rejects private inputs. Synthetic topology validates wiring; native Chromium tests validate real broker-only process path. Do not claim real public Internet reachability from mapped loopback.
harnessDesign.https: Complete TLS using normally trusted controlled-domain cert/key provisioned offline, or separately approved process/profile-scoped test trust. No ignore-certificate-errors/AlwaysAllow/global CA/permanent trust.
harnessDesign.tlsUnresolved: If no compliant trust mechanism is available, HTTPS positive native proof stays BLOCKED; no virtual-host HTTPS mapping as substitute.
harnessDesign.processObservation: Owned PID tree/time/config/broker + calibrated TCP/UDP/DNS canaries and host observation; snapshot-only tables insufficient. No silent admin/global networking dependency.
harnessDesign.fixtures: Static controlled servers; same and second origin; HTTP/TLS redirects/subresources/WS/WSS. Secret content/logs not required.
harnessDesign.cleanup: Only resources created by future harness, ownership checked. No maintenance of 36 historical UDFs.
